name: @dimarborda/xlsx
description: Excel (.xlsx) library for Node.js and the browser: Rust + WebAssembly engine that edits workbooks without losing what it does not touch
author: Dimar Borda

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "require('fs').accessSync('wasm/xlsx_engine_bg.wasm')" || (echo 'Falta el motor WebAssembly: publica con npm run release -- --pkg=xlsx desde la raíz del repositorio' && exit 1)
